#   TurrisTech › Sentinel Attackers
#   
#   This blocklist is generated from the Turris Sentinel network, a distributed
#   security telemetry system run on Turris routers that reports suspicious
#   and malicious activity observed in real-world traffic.
#   
#   It contains IP addresses associated with automated attacks such as SSH
#   brute-force attempts, service probing, and other unauthorized access
#   behavior detected across participating devices.
#   
#   The list is intended for defensive blocking and reputation-based filtering
#   of actively observed attacker infrastructure.
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malformed data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
